Name: EO-IR Sensor Parameters
Description: The SENSRA TRE provides information about the sensor's geospatial position, attitude, dynamics, and other parameters needed for computing accurate and precise geolocations from the imagery.

REF_ROW.Name: Reference Row
REF_ROW.Description: The data in this extension was collected at REF_ROW of the imaging operation. This field identifies the point at which the data fo this extension was valid during extended imaging operations.

REF_COL.Name: Reference Column
REF_COL.Description: The data in this extension was collected at REF_COL of the imaging operation. This field identifies the point at which the data of this extension was valid during extended imaging operations.

SENSOR_MODEL.Name: Sensor Model Name
SENSOR_MODEL.Description: This field identifies which specific sensor produced the image. See "FieldRegistry" SENSRA SENSOR_MODEL, as defined in the main body of STDI-0002 Volume 1, paragraph 3.2 for values added through registration.

SENSOR_MOUNT.Name: Sensor Mounting Pitch Angle
SENSOR_MOUNT.Description: This field ontains the angle in degrees between the longitudinal centerline of the platform and the sensor scan axix. Normally this is only applicable to push broom sensors.

SENSOR_LOC.Name: Sensor Location
SENSOR_LOC.Description: The earth coordinate of the sensor location ma be expressed in either degrees-minutes-seconds or in decimal degrees. See section E.2.1 for further detail on expressing coordinates.

SENSOR_ALT_SOURCE.Name: Sensor Altitude Source
SENSOR_ALT_SOURCE.Description: This field identifies the source for the value in SENSOR_ALT (and associated reference level). B = Barometric Altimeter (MSL), G = Global Positioning System (WGS-84 Ellipsoid), M = Manual Entry (undetermined), R = Radar Alimeter (AGL). See "FieldRegistry" SENSRA SENSOR_ALT_SOURCE, as defined in the main body of STDI-0002 Volume 1, paragraph 3.2 for values added through registration.

SENSOR_ALT.Name: Sensor Altitude
SENSOR_ALT.Description: This field contains the altitude above reference level specified by SENSOR_ALT_SOURCE. This field is measured in feet or meters, as specified by SENSOR_ALT_UNIT.

SENSOR_ALT_UNIT.Name: Unit of Sensor Altitude
SENSOR_ALT_UNIT.Description: This field applies to both SENSOR_ALT and SENSOR_AGL, and may be null if both altitudes are null. f = feet and m = meters.

SENSOR_AGL.Name: Sensor Radar Altitude
SENSOR_AGL.Description: This field contains the altitude above ground level (AGL), measured in feet or meters, as specified by SENSOR_ALT_UNIT. This field is filled with spaces when not available or outside equipment operating range.

SENSOR_PITCH.Name: Sensor Pitch Angle
SENSOR_PITCH.Description: This field contains the sensor pitch angle. An indeterminacy occurs when the sensor optical axis is parallel to the platform pitch axis, in which case the field is set to +00.000.

SENSOR_ROLL.Name: Sensor Roll Angle
SENSOR_ROLL.Description: This field contains the sensor roll angle. An indeterminacy occurs when the sensor optical axis is parallel to the platform roll axis, in which case the field is set to +000.000.

SENSOR_YAW.Name: Sensor Yaw Angle
SENSOR_YAW.Description: This field contains the sensor yaw angle. An indeterminacy occurs when the sensor opitcal axis is parallel to the platform yaw axix, in which case the field is set to +000.000.

PLATFORM_PITCH.Name: Platform Pitch
PLATFORM_PITCH.Description: This field contains the platform pitch. For more information, see Appendix Z: SENSRB.

PLATFORM_ROLL.Name: Platform Roll
PLATFORM_ROLL.Description: This field contains platform roll. For more information, see Appendix Z: SENSRB.

PLATFORM_HDG.Name: Platform Heading
PLATFORM_HDG.Description: This field contains platform heading. For more information, see Appendix Z: SENSRB. An indeterminacy occurs when PLATFORM_PITCH is -90.000 or +90.000, in which case this field is 000.0.

GROUND_SPD_SOURCE.Name: Ground Speed Source
GROUND_SPD_SOURCE.Description: This field contains the ground speed source. R = Doppler Radar, N = Navigation System, G = Global Positioning System, and M = Manual Entry. A space (0x20) = unknown.

GROUND_SPD.Name: Ground Speed
GROUND_SPD.Description: This field contains the ground speed as reported by GROUND_SPD_SOURCE at the time of imagery collection.

GROUND_SPD_UNIT.Name: Unit of Ground Speed
GROUND_SPD_UNIT.Description: This field contains the unit of GROUND_SPD, and may be null if GROUND_SPD is null. k = knots, f = feet/sec, and m = meters/sec. See "FieldRegistry" SENSRA SENSOR_GROUND_SPD_UNIT, as defined in the main body of STDI-0002 Volume 1, paragraph 3.2 for values added through registration.

GROUND_TRACK.Name: Ground Track
GROUND_TRACK.Description: This field contains the angle from north to the horizontal projection of the platform path (positive from north to east).

VERT_VEL.Name: Vertical Velocity
VERT_VEL.Description: This field contains the vertical velocity, measured in either feet/min or meters/min, as specified by VERT_VEL_UNIT.

VERT_VEL_UNIT.Name: Unit of Vertical Velocity
VERT_VEL_UNIT.Description: This field conains the unit of vertical velocity and may be null only if VERT_VEL is null. f = feet/minute and m = meters/minute.

SWATH_FRAMES.Name: Number of Frames per Swath
SWATH_FRAMES.Description: This field contains the number of frames per swath. A swath is a continuous strip of frames swept out by the scanning motion of certain dynamic sensors. Platform dynamics may cause the number of frames to vary from one swath to another.

N_SWATHS.Name: Number of Swaths
N_SWATHS.Description: This field contains the number of swaths in this TRE.

SPOT_NUM.Name: Spot Number
SPOT_NUM.Description: This field contains the spot number in point targets mode.
